revisions.title: Electronic Version of NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 Controls and SP 800-53A Rev 5 Assessment Procedures
revisions.remarks: This OSCAL version of the SP 800-53 Revision 5.1.1 catalog restores the non-padded prop/@name=\"label\" for all controls, for backwards compatibility and adds prop/@name=\"label\" with class=\"zero-padded\" to support and encourage users' transission to zero-padded control IDs. This SP 800-53 Revision 5.1.1 catalog preserves all content changes of the previous 5.1.1+u3 release: one new control (IA-13), three control enhancements, minor grammatical edits/clarifications that do not impact the implementation or outcome of the controls and introduces “leading 0s” to the control identifiers.
